study_title: Previous-Day Extreme Sweep Rejection Mechanism Study

independence_contract.parallel_study: Asian Low Sweep Post-Sweep Rebound Mechanism Study

primary_hypothesis: A temporary source-native Bid sweep of the previous UTC trading-day High or Low that fails to obtain outside acceptance and is confirmed by a completed M15 close back inside the previous-day range has a short-horizon rejection edge opposite the sweep.
auxiliary_hypotheses: Previous-Day Low Sweep Long and Previous-Day High Sweep Short may be structurally asymmetric.
Profitable rejection may be identified only by information fixed by the entry decision timestamp.
Outside acceptance is economically distinct from rejection and is more likely to continue away from the previous-day range.
The mechanism may contribute positively on B02/F05 negative days with low daily correlation.
Complementarity must survive concentration, cost and full-equity portfolio tests.

period_roles.2025H2_access_condition: unchanged candidate passes every 2025H1 binding gate

previous_day_calendar_contract.eligible_trading_day: weekday with source-native ticks and complete-day coverage under the completeness contract
previous_day_calendar_contract.previous_trading_day: latest prior eligible trading day; Saturday/Sunday and verified no-tick market holidays are skipped
previous_day_calendar_contract.monday_rule: normally Friday; otherwise latest prior complete eligible trading day
previous_day_calendar_contract.holiday_rule: skip only when the source manifest proves no ticks for the entire UTC day and adjacent eligible days pass completeness
previous_day_calendar_contract.partial_day_rule: do not use as a boundary source and do not bridge silently; block source authority
previous_day_calendar_contract.missing_tick_day_rule: unexplained missing eligible weekday is a binding source-authority failure

boundary_price_definition.previous_day_high: maximum source-native Bid during the previous trading-day interval
boundary_price_definition.previous_day_low: minimum source-native Bid during the previous trading-day interval
boundary_price_definition.sweep_cross: Bid > previous_day_high for High sweep; Bid < previous_day_low for Low sweep
boundary_price_definition.reclaim: Bid returns strictly inside the boundary
boundary_price_definition.ask_diagnostics: Ask extremes and Bid/Ask spread are retained for audit but do not redefine Atlas-compatible event identity

source_authority.primary: Dukascopy BI5-derived source-native USDJPY Bid/Ask Tick immutable annual Releases
source_authority.historical_releases: must be inventoried and frozen only after candidate freeze
source_authority.external_releases: 2025 authority remains unopened until pre-2025 authorization

base_event_contract.event_population: first source-native Bid cross of either previous-day boundary for each current trading date and side
base_event_contract.both_side_sweep: retain separate side events and mark both_side_sweep=true; never silently suppress
base_event_contract.same_day_repeated_sweep: retain first cross as identity event; later crosses are path diagnostics and retest_count

atlas_compatible_rejection_signal.m15_bar: UTC-aligned completed M15 bar containing or following the first sweep
atlas_compatible_rejection_signal.high_sweep_short: bar Bid high > previous_day_high AND bar Bid close < previous_day_high
atlas_compatible_rejection_signal.low_sweep_long: bar Bid low < previous_day_low AND bar Bid close > previous_day_low
atlas_compatible_rejection_signal.entry: first source-native tick timestamp >= decision_time; Long at Ask, Short at Bid
atlas_compatible_rejection_signal.exit: first source-native tick timestamp >= exit_boundary; Long at Bid, Short at Ask

base_event_contract.active_position_suppression: variant-local; no overlapping accepted position for the same candidate
base_event_contract.fold_boundary: event, entry and fixed exit must remain in the same half-year fold
base_event_contract.unresolved_policy: retain in mismatch ledger and apply binding integrity gate

monetary_contract.floating_pl: Long marked to Bid; Short marked to Ask; same 1000 JPY per price unit
monetary_contract.currency_conversion: none; USDJPY quote P/L is directly JPY
monetary_contract.floating_noise_normalization: absolute values below tolerance normalized to zero

core_mt4_access_condition: all 2020-2022 historical validation binding gates pass
external_2025_access_condition: candidate freeze, historical validation, Core parity, MT4 native execution and full-equity parity all pass
